lines: Cherry blossoms, fluttering down, drifting and falling
I held close all the fullness of my swaying longing
That dream you and I wished on in spring
I can still see it now, as the blossoms scatter
What I saw from the train was a face from long ago
The spring bridge we crossed together
Graduation came, and you left our hometown
On the tinted riverbank I search for that day
We each chose our own road, and our spring came to an end
Tomorrow blooming in full glory makes me impatient
In the window of the Odakyu line, the cherry blossoms appear again this year
I can hear your voice in this heart of mine

I can still see it now, as the blossoms scatter

A little lie like that, you'd see right through it, wouldn't you
This town, turning round and round, welcomes spring again
This year too, those flowers open their buds
Getting past the days without you, I'm growing up too
Is this how I'll forget it all, I wonder
"I really did love you" — I reach my hand toward the blossoms
This longing is now being wrapped up in spring

I drew close all the fullness of my swaying longing
Those strong words you gave me
Still remain in my heart, as the blossoms drift along

I start walking toward the far side of spring
